name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 6 – Am 9
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 6b. Expresses its opposition to the allocation of budgetary appropriations to militarism, namely for war, weapons and military infrastructure, capacity and mobility; is against the growing militarisation of the EU; calls strongly for the reallocation of funds from the EU budget earmarked for militarisation programmes, redirecting them towards helping Member States to improve the economic and social picture on the basis of the principle of social and economic cohesion, to step up the responsiveness of public services, including in health, education and social security, and to uphold the right to decent and affordable housing for all;
